name: Firfire
desc:
One of the least hostile parts of [Floor 1](location:the_ethironal_shrine), Firfire is located above the [Firfire Caverns](location:firfire_caverns) and is home to various friendly Kyrsgarde and a quest. It is necessary to visit this location in a run to open the way to [Chaser, Scholar of the Crimson Contract](entity:chaser_scholar_of_the_crimson_contract).

Firfire does not have active wind or snowfall. Previously existing parasites will remain, but they do not progress or build up while in Firfire.
additional_info:
-   The music for this area is Whisperwind by Naktigonis.
-   After using the resting emote near Makolis Pariah Katatonicus, if you talk to him in future runs he will label you as "Friendwalker" instead of "Fringe/Frinwalker."
